mug_yuki: Highly volatile with no fixed time-based pattern. Observed at kitchen_table_k1 (08:33, 14:00), desk_b1 (09:05, 10:30, 08:56, 14:00, 21:35, 09:29, 15:18), coffee_table_l1 (22:26, 21:46, 21:00, 21:55), and cupboard_k1 (day 6). Do not assume cupboard_k1 or a single location based on time. Check desk_b1, kitchen_table_k1, and coffee_table_l1, prioritizing the most recent confirmed location.

glass_yuki: Location is variable and does not follow the "cupboard_k1 after 22:00" rule. Observed at kitchen_table_k1 (13:30, 21:33, 20:31), counter_k1 (16:10, 17:00), and nightstand_b1 (day 6). Do not assume cupboard_k1 is the only late-night spot. Check kitchen_table_k1, counter_k1, and nightstand_b1, prioritizing the most recent confirmed location.

water_bottle_yuki: Frequently located at desk_b1, but also found at kitchen_table_k1 (19:37, 21:31, 20:30). Do not assume desk_b1 is the only location for evening queries. Check desk_b1 for morning queries and kitchen_table_k1 for evening queries, prioritizing the most recent confirmed location.

tablet_yuki: Moves to kitchen_table_k1 in the morning, not desk_b1. Found at kitchen_table_k1 at 09:37. Previous note about nightstand_b1 in late afternoon remains valid. Check kitchen_table_k1 for morning queries.

charger_yuki: Often found at desk_b1, not nightstand_b1. Found at desk_b1 at 21:15. Check desk_b1 for evening/night queries.

General Pattern: Yuki’s items are less predictable than previously noted. Mug and glass locations shift frequently without a clear time-based anchor. Tablet moves to kitchen_table_k1 in the morning. Water bottle and charger have specific preferred spots (desk_b1 and desk_b1 respectively) that differ from previous assumptions. Always verify the most recent known location for mug and glass, and check specific preferred spots for tablet, water bottle, and charger. Avoid rigid time-based assumptions for these items.
